Landing.heroSubtitle: A simple prediction game that turns into a real cycling strategy game.
Landing.featuresEyebrow: Easy to play, rich to master
Landing.f1Title: A simple game: 3 riders per stage
Landing.f1Body: Before each stage, pick 3 riders. 30 seconds is all it takes, and you can change your mind until the start.
Landing.f1Pin1: The odds: the higher they are, the more the rider earns. Dare to back the outsider?
Landing.f1Pin2: Your 3 picks, that's it. A rider you pick is "burned" for the next stage of the race: mix up your choices.
Landing.f1Pin3: Predictions close when the stage starts.
Landing.f2Title: You score if your riders finish in the Top 10
Landing.f2Body: Each rider earns their odds multiplied according to their place. Hundreds of points are at stake in every stage.
Landing.f2Pin1: Winning pays: odds × 25 for 1st, down to × 1 for 10th.
Landing.f2Pin2: A well-placed outsider earns more than a winning favourite.
Landing.f2Pin3: Bonus if your 3 picks finish in the Top 10 (+20), Top 5 (+50) or on the podium (+100). And +200 for the perfect prediction.
Landing.f3Body: Create your league, share the code and follow your own ranking, on top of the overall standings.
Landing.f3Pin1: A code to send to your friends, family or colleagues so they can join you.
Landing.f3Pin2: Yellow jersey for the season leader, red bib for the best player of each race.
Landing.f3Pin3: You, neck and neck: every stage can change everything.
Landing.f4Body: Special stages with bonuses or penalties, bonus cards, World Championships that count double: the standings stay open until the last stage.
Landing.f4Pin1: Special stages, announced in advance, change the rules: here, every penalty loop costs you points.
Landing.f4Pin2: Score points in 10 stages in a row and win a bonus card, to play whenever you choose.
Landing.f4Pin3: The World Championships count double, and you have 3 ×2 boosts to use during the season.
Landing.mockSpecialRule: −20 pts per penalty loop of your riders
Landing.faqTitle: Everything to know before the start
Landing.faq_free_a: Yes, 100%. No real money, no cash prizes: you play for fun, glory and the yellow jersey.
Landing.faq_account_q: Do I need an account to start?
Landing.faq_account_a: Not right away. Tap "I'm in": the next stage opens and you make your picks. You're only asked for an account when you confirm, with a simple code sent by email, no password.
Landing.faq_when_q: Until when can I make or change my picks?
Landing.faq_when_a: Predictions for a race open one week before it starts. You can change them as often as you like until each stage starts, then they're locked.
Landing.faq_points_q: How many points can I win on a stage?
Landing.faq_points_a: Hundreds. Each Top 10 rider earns their odds multiplied according to their place: × 25 for the winner, × 18 for 2nd… down to × 1 for 10th. Like the World Cup scale, it rewards winning first and foremost. A rider with odds of 9 who wins already brings in 225 points, before the Top 10, Top 5, Podium and Perfect prediction bonuses.
Landing.faq_relays_a: Yes. On a relay you pick a nation, and only the top 5 score (odds × 10 for the win). There are fewer points at stake than in individual stages, so consistency makes the difference.
Landing.faq_mistakes_q: What if I miss a stage or get it wrong?
Landing.faq_mistakes_a: You're allowed mistakes. At the end of the season, your 3 worst individual stage results and your 2 worst relays are dropped, starting with the stages you didn't play. Only the World Championships and Olympics are never dropped. Jokers only apply to the overall season standings: race rankings don't change.
Landing.faq_special_a: Some stages, announced in advance, have an exceptional rule. Penalty loop: each penalty loop by your riders costs 20 points, and a rider not picked counts as 5 loops (-100). Fog: a rider outside the Top 10 costs you as many points as their place. Busted: penalty if your picks finish outside the Top 10. National Day: riders from your favourite team earn double.
Landing.faq_cards_q: How do I win bonus cards?
Landing.faq_cards_a: By scoring points in 10 stages in a row, relays included: that's the 10/10. You then pick your card, for example Boost (×3 on one rider), Barbecue (un-burn your riders) or 4th pick (4 riders, the best 3 count). Play it at the right time to turn the standings upside down.
Landing.faq_team_a: Pick your colours for the season, for example France Women or Norway Men, and follow their wins and podiums from your home page. Your team can also earn you points: double on National Day, and with the Team card at the end of the season.
Landing.faq_standings_a: The overall standings add up all your points of the season: the leader wears the yellow jersey. After each race, a race ranking decides who wears the red bib. And every league has its own ranking.
Landing.faq_worlds_q: Can the standings still change late in the season?
Landing.faq_worlds_a: Yes, and that's the whole point. The World Championships count double, a well-played bonus card can earn big, and the season globes are awarded at the end of the winter. Nothing is decided before the last stage.
Landing.finalSubtitle: Pick your 3 riders in 30 seconds and join the race for the yellow jersey.
Landing.footerDisclaimer: VéloPronos is an independent cycling prediction game. No real money wagered. No financial winnings.
Landing.faq_burnt_a: A rider you picked isn't available for the next stage of the same race. Mix up your choices and save your favourites for the right moment. Everyone is available again at the next race, and the Barbecue card lets you bypass the rule once.

Regles.title: The rules
Regles.subtitle: Everything you need in 5 minutes
Regles.intro: Predict which riders will perform, play their odds, use your bonuses at the right time and try to grab the Yellow jersey as the season's best predictor.
Regles.golden2Body: A well-chosen outsider earns more than a favourite.
Regles.golden3Body: A bad weekend is never final.
Regles.pickBody: For each individual stage, pick 3 riders. The riskier your pick (high odds), the more it can earn, but they must finish in the Top 10. Your prediction locks at the start of the stage.
Regles.scaleTitle: Scale: odds × multiplier by finishing place
Regles.comboBody: Your 3 picks together can earn you a bonus on top of their points.
Regles.comboPerfectDesc: The 3 riders who scored the most
Regles.oddsBody: Each rider has odds for each stage format. Favourites have the lowest odds, outsiders the highest: they can earn much more.
Regles.oddsWhen: Odds are reassessed at key moments of the season: Christmas break, end of January, after the World Championships or Olympics.
Regles.pursuitBody: After the sprint, pursuit odds are recalculated automatically: +5 for every 20 s behind the winner. The first 20 s are neutral, and odds are capped at 50.
Regles.pursuitExample: Example: base odds 10, gap in the sprint
Regles.relayBody: You predict a nation instead of 3 riders. Only the top 5 nations score, with a lower scale than individual stages.
Regles.x2Body: Doubles every point of a prediction, on a World Cup individual stage or relay. Not on the World Championships/Olympics or special stages.
Regles.worldsBody: Every stage of these events automatically counts double. Not stackable with your personal ×2 bonus, and no bonus card can be played there.
Regles.fgBody: Two 10/10 bonus cards that reward the essence of cycling: skiing and shooting. Play them on a race before its 1st stage and they count in all its individual stages. Fixed points (doubled by your ×2 bonus), stackable across your 3 riders, even outside the Top 10. Not with Boost, nor at the Worlds/Olympics.
Regles.fuseeDesc: Per rider with a top 3 ski time: +100, +50 or +20.
Regles.gachetteDesc: Per rider who shoots 20/20 (+50 for a 10/10 in the sprint).
Regles.questionsBody: On some stages, answer a question to earn extra points. You can change your answer while it is open.
Regles.questionsBeforeDesc: 2 to 4 answers, on the stage page, until the start.
Regles.questionsLiveDesc: 2 answers, open for a few minutes during the stage. A notification warns you.
Regles.streakBody: Score points in 10 stages in a row (relays included) and win a bonus card of your choice. A stage without points resets the counter.
Regles.streakRules: The same card can't be taken twice in a row. {farte} doesn't stack with a ×2 (never ×6), nor with Rocket or Trigger. {farte} can be played during a {fourth}, {aspiration} can't. No cards at the Worlds/Olympics.
Regles.specialIntro: Some stages have an exceptional rule, announced in advance. No ×2 bonus on these stages.
Regles.penaDesc: Per penalty loop by your riders. A rider not picked counts as 5 loops (-100 pts).
Regles.fogDesc: Outside the Top 10, a malus equal to the finishing place: 13th = −13 pts, 48th = −48 pts.
Regles.colleDesc: A malus if your picks finish outside the Top 10:
Regles.feteDesc: Your picked riders from your favourite team (nation and sex) who finish in the Top 10 score double. Not stackable with another ×2 ({farte} stays at ×3).
Regles.globesBody: Before the season starts, 6 predictions: the overall globe, the best young athlete and the best nation, for women and for men.
Regles.globeBigScale: Overall globe: rewards the final Top 5
Regles.globeSmallScale: Young and nation: reward the podium
Regles.pepiteBody: A bet at the start of the season on one outsider per sex, which other players can't see. It is played secretly on every individual stage: on its first Top 10 of the season, the points it earns in that stage are added to your stage score. It is then revealed (❄️ in the standings) and becomes a regular athlete again. Until it is revealed, you can't include it in your stage picks. The Talent card then lets you reactivate it or pick a new one.
Regles.jokersBody: At the end of the season, your worst results are wiped (never the World Championships, the Olympics, or malus and bonus stages). A stage you didn't play is wiped first. Wiping a result removes its points: a 0 costs nothing.
Regles.jokersPreview: Preview during the season in Standings, “My ranking” box.
Regles.generalBody: Adds up every point of the season. The leader wears the Yellow jersey.
Regles.stageBody: The points of a single race. Its leader wears the Red Bib, and everyone shows their race wins.
Regles.leaguesBody: Create your league, share the code and take on your friends in standings of your own.
Regles.finalBody: Pick your 3 riders. Check the stage profile. Keep your cards for the right moment. And above all… avoid the puncture.
Regles.burntBody: A rider you pick is unavailable for the next stage of the same race. Mix up your picks!
Regles.burntNote: When the race changes, everyone is available again. The {fondue} card also lets you un-burn your riders once.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: VéloPronos ("the Application") respects its users' privacy. This privacy policy explains what personal data is collected, how it is used, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: When you use the Application, we collect:
bullets: Predictions, bonus cards and game history
Sign-in data (email and password, or OAuth provider: Google, Apple)
sections.note: We do not collect any bank or payment data: the game is entirely free.

sections.title: 3. Use of data
paragraphs: The data collected is used exclusively to:
bullets: Provide the game features (predictions, standings, globes, leagues)

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
paragraphs: Your personal data is never sold or rented to third parties.
Some data may be processed by our technical providers (hosting, database, authentication) strictly to run the service.

sections.title: 5. Third-party sign-in (OAuth)
paragraphs: The application offers sign-in with Google and Apple. These sign-ins are subject to those providers' privacy policies, and we never receive your password. If you sign in by email, your password is stored encrypted by our authentication provider: we never have access to it in plain text.

sections.title: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Your rights (GDPR)
paragraphs: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
bullets: Right of access to your personal data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")

sections.title: 8. Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable technical and organisational security measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or disclosure.

sections.title: 9. Contact
paragraphs: For any question about this privacy policy:

RuleInfo.title: How does it work?
RuleInfo.individual: Pick 3 riders. Each one scores if they finish in the Top 10: their odds × 25 for a win, × 18 for 2nd place… down to × 1 for 10th. Bonus if your 3 picks all finish in the Top 3, Top 5 or Top 10.
RuleInfo.fusee: Rocket card played on the race: +100 / +50 / +20 pts per rider with the 3 fastest ski times.
RuleInfo.gachette: Trigger card played on the race: +100 pts per 20/20 shooting, +50 per 10/10 in the sprint.
RuleInfo.pursuitStart: Athletes start in the order of the sprint results, and odds are re-evaluated based on the time gap.
RuleInfo.relay: For relays, pick a single team: it scores if it finishes in the Top 5 (its odds × 10 for a win, then × 6, × 4, × 2 and × 1).
RuleInfo.x2: Until the start, you can change your prediction and activate a ×2 bonus (3 per season).
RuleInfo.grilled: Riders picked for the previous stage of the race are burned: you can't pick them again.

BonusCards.title: Bonus cards
BonusCards.claimButton: {count, plural, one {🎉 5 stages in a row! Choose your bonus card} other {🎉 Choose your # bonus cards}}
BonusCards.claimTitle: Well done, 5 stages in a row!
BonusCards.claimIntro: {count, plural, one {You scored points on 5 stages in a row. Choose your card: it is played in this race.} other {You have # bonus cards to choose, to play in this race.}}
BonusCards.claimError: The card couldn't be saved. Try again.
BonusCards.desc_ca_farte: Keep it in hand: a ×3 on one of your riders, on the stage of your choice in this race (not with your ×2).
BonusCards.desc_balle_de_pioche: Activates right away for the next 3 stages of the race: 4 riders instead of 3, your best 3 count. All 4 are grilled the next day.
BonusCards.desc_aspiration: Keep it in hand: on an individual stage of your choice, each of your riders counts one place higher (an 11th becomes 10th and scores).
BonusCards.desc_equipe: Grand Tours: activates right away; from stage 10, each rider of your favourite team in the Top 10 earns you their odds once more, picked or not.
BonusCards.lockedUntil_equipe: Grand Tour and favourite team chosen
BonusCards.desc_fusee: Play it on a race before its 1st stage: in all its individual stages, +100 pts per picked rider with the fastest ski time, +50 for the 2nd, +20 for the 3rd. Even outside the Top 10.
BonusCards.desc_gachette: Play it on a race before its 1st stage: in all its individual stages, +100 pts per picked rider who shoots 20/20 (+50 for a 10/10 in the sprint). Even outside the Top 10.
BonusCards.desc_talent: One of your Hidden Diamonds has been revealed? Reactivate it (it becomes hidden again and scores on its next Top 10) or pick a new one, for the men or for the women.
BonusCards.talentPlayHint: Talent card: reactivate or change your Diamond
BonusCards.stagePlayNone: No upcoming race to play it on (not at the Worlds/Olympics, nor with Boost).
BonusCards.stagePlayError: The card couldn't be played. Try again.
BonusCards.desc_fondue: Keep it in hand: ungrills your riders once, on the stage of your choice in this race.
BonusCards.desc_chat_noir: Keep it in hand: replaces one of your jersey picks (except best team) or your water carrier if their rider abandons, until the first rest day from stage 8 on.

Jerseys.title: My jerseys
Jerseys.intro: Predict the final winner of each classification. You can change it until the first stage starts.
Jerseys.closed: The race has started: jersey predictions are closed.
Jerseys.pointsRule: Final top 3 of each jersey: odds ×5 for the winner, ×2 for 2nd, ×1 for 3rd.
Jerseys.combatifRule: Super combative: +200 if elected, +50 each day he is the most combative rider.

Jerseys.searchRider: Search a rider, team or nation
Jerseys.noRiders: The start list is not known yet: come back shortly before the start.
Jerseys.noJerseys: No jersey predictions for this race.
Jerseys.waterCarrierHint: An outsider whose odds for the race are all at least 30. Nobody else sees them. They are secretly added to all your stage predictions: at their first Top 10, their stage points are added to your score, once only. Until then, you can't put them in your predictions. Can be changed until the start of stage 1.

Jerseys.waterCarrierChoose: Choose your hidden outsider for this Grand Tour
